Reference: BW-DE-0417

Brightwell Analytics builds demand-forecasting software for grocery chains. Our data platform team owns the pipelines
that feed every forecast, and we are hiring a senior engineer to grow it. You will work with the data scientists, and
you will own the quality of the tables that we publish.
